mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM app_role r JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.enabled=1 ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM app_user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN app_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.enabled=1 ORDER BY rp.permission_code
SELECT role_id FROM app_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT id,code,name,enabled,built_in FROM app_role ORDER BY id
SELECT id,code,name,enabled,built_in FROM app_role WHERE id=#{roleId}
SELECT code,name,category FROM app_permission ORDER BY category,code
SELECT permission_code FROM app_role_permission WHERE role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT user_id FROM app_user_role WHERE role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user_security s JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=s.user_id SET s.auth_version=s.auth_version+1 WHERE ur.role_id=#{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id,u.username,u.display_name,u.org_id,o.name AS org_name,u.enabled FROM app_user u JOIN organization o ON o.id=u.org_id JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN app_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN app_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id WHERE u.org_id=#{orgId} AND u.id != #{excludeUserId} AND u.enabled=1 AND r.enabled=1 AND rp.permission_code='approval:review:audit' ORDER BY u.id
